scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const d='node_modules/sql.js/dist';if(fs.existsSync(d)){fs.readdirSync(d).forEach(f=>{if(!f.match(/^(sql-asm\.js|sql-wasm\.js|sql-wasm\.wasm)$/)){try{const fp=p.join(d,f);fs.statSync(fp).isDirectory()?fs.rmSync(fp,{recursive:true}):fs.unlinkSync(fp)}catch(e){}}});console.log('Cleaned sql.js dist')}" && echo ok
